short_description: Edmonton painter & renovator. Interior/exterior painting, drywall repair, refreshes. Free written quotes by text or email.
long_description: Residential painting and home renovation for Edmonton and area. I do interior repaints, exterior siding and trim, drywall repair, and refresh work — prepped properly and finished clean. Quotes are free, in writing, and by text or email (I keep phone tag out of the process). Trade-grade paint lines; materials included or labour-only, your choice. Serving Edmonton, St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Leduc, Beaumont and Fort Saskatchewan.
